testCases.label: Verify foreign key table allows valid inserts
testCases.description: Runs problem1() to create the site_user and post tables with a foreign key constraint, then attempts to insert a post referencing user ID 1. Test passes if no exception is thrown.

testCases.label: Verify foreign key constraint prevents invalid inserts
testCases.description: Runs problem1() to set up the foreign key constraint, then attempts to insert a post referencing nonexistent user ID 100. Test passes only if a foreign key violation exception is thrown.
